title: UFO whistleblower claims Trump is hiding four alien species' bodies
description: Dr. Eric Davis claims to have seen evidence of four distinct alien species and is seeking legal immunity to disclose scientific reports on non-human life forms.

title: Metals recovered by Russia from alleged UFO appear not from earth: Coulthart
Panicked Airbus pilot ducked when dark UFO shot past in terrifying near miss at 6,500ft
description: AN Airbus pilot "ducked" in panic in his cockpit when his passenger jet came "within metres" of a dark UFO flying over London. The shocking incident happened on 1 June this year as the plane was flying at 6,500ft over Stamford Hill. It comes after two other passenger jets had near misses with unknown objects...

title: NASA Scientist Reportedly Used Telepathy to Stop UFO Looking Like 'Giant Nuclear Weapon' After Military Bailed
